quotes.text: The resulting task description is the fully specified prompt and represents the only context provided to the agent.
Train on two variations per task and evaluate on three unseen variations per task.

parsed.rationale: The prompt is the agent's only context and memory is trained on separate variations or held-out tasks, which acts as a cross-task memory control. The held-out split is partial: the benchmark data is public on GitHub per the data availability statement. No canary or provenance marker is reported.
